title: HPLC Chromatography Mobile Phase Degassing & Baseline Drift
description: Intermediate chemical synthesis and analytical module analyzing hplc chromatography mobile phase degassing & baseline drift.
learning_objectives: Master professional First & Second Conditionals in organic API synthesis and QC analysis
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in hplc chromatography mobile phase degassing & baseline drift
Demonstrate precision in HPLC, Karl Fischer, and pharmacopeial compliance documentation

questions.prompt: If the mobile phase degassing unit _____ during run 4, the HPLC baseline will exhibit excessive noise.

explanations.correct: First conditional if-clause takes Present Simple ('fails') for real physical consequences.
explanations.wrong_C: Cannot use 'would' in a real First Conditional.
explanations.wrong_D: Past tense 'failed' creates an unreal condition, mismatched with 'will exhibit'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Never use 'will' in the if-clause of analytical troubleshooting (*If the pump will fail*). Use Present Simple: 'If the pump fails'.
